android-auto|certification-1st|invehicle.text:
The in-vehicle pre-test is currently scheduled to start on March 15, but we can coordinate to bring it forward to February 22 (after the Lunar New Year holiday).

  • Early December Pre-test: The primary focus will be on Location testing. The US-based TS team can provide support and assist with connectivity-related activities.

  • Android Auto In-Vehicle Pre-test: Since the audio functionality is not yet ready and some bugs remain unresolved, full pre-test coverage cannot be achieved at this stage.

  • ITU-T Testing: The current target completion date is March 14, with vehicle allocation planned as follows:

    • Internal Amplifier Vehicle: 4 weeks (early January to the end of January).

      • Vehicle availability and usage can be further coordinated with Cerence.

    • External Amplifier Vehicle: 4 weeks (early February to the end of February).

      • During January, the external amplifier vehicle can be allocated to CarPlay Location testing.

  • 3PL Audit: By bringing forward the in-vehicle pre-test, we can complete it before the 3PL audit begins.

目前在3月15日開始，可以協調提前至2月22日 (農曆新年後)
  • 12月初的Pretest是針對Location test，美國TS可以協助跟連結相關協助
  • 針對AA的In vehicle test因為Audio功能還沒有好，所以Pretest項目無法全覆蓋，而且bug還沒有全部解除
  • ITU-T目前是抓3/14完成，其用車時間如下:
    • Internal Amplifier 4 周 (1月初~1月底)
      • 可與Cerence溝通用車時間
    • External Amplifier 4 周 (2月初~2月底)
      • 此時(1月份)External的車子可以先給Carplay做location測試
  • 由於把In vehicle test提前，所以可以在3PL audit前完成
